guard: user bearer goal follows survive wire expiry rebuilds, stop cleanly, check compatibility and fingerprints, and preserve error provenance
why: An accepted goal must be followable across resident connection wire expiry without silent hangs.
An unsupported manager lacking goal-result must be refused before effects, while stop must cancel active follows immediately.
Reconciled facts must validate fingerprint and outcomeDigest, and lookup errors must never copy bind-refusal onto the mutation.

mutations.name: M1 skip stop cancellation of active followers
mutations.expectRed: STOP: settled in <200ms without waiting out deadline
mutations.cell: STOP: settled in <200ms without waiting out deadline
mutations.note: Stopping endpoint must cancel active followers immediately without waiting out deadline.

mutations.name: M2 skip goal-result check in compatibility gate
mutations.expectRed: COMPAT: message provides actionable upgrade notice
mutations.cell: COMPAT: message provides actionable upgrade notice
mutations.note: Compatibility gate must refuse before effects when goal-result is missing.

mutations.name: M3 skip accepted fingerprint validation on reconciled fact
mutations.expectRed: FACT: mismatched fingerprint does not authorize
mutations.cell: FACT: mismatched fingerprint does not authorize
mutations.note: Reconciled fact fingerprint must match accepted goal fingerprint.

mutations.name: M4 skip lookup refusal provenance guard
mutations.find: const isRefusal = typeof err === "object" && err !== null && "isLookupRefusal" in err && Boolean((err as { isLookupRefusal: boolean }).isLookupRefusal);
mutations.note: Lookup refusal must be caught and converted to distinct observation failure.

mutations.name: M5 skip pre-deadline fallback reconciliation
mutations.expectRed: GAP: followServiceGoal resolves ok: true via reconciliation
mutations.cell: GAP: followServiceGoal resolves ok: true via reconciliation
mutations.note: Pre-deadline fallback must reconcile terminal committed during gap.
